top.title: Amex introduces a framework to prevent AI agents from making unauthorized purchases
top.summary: American Express is introducing a new framework designed to ensure AI agents only make purchases their users have authorized, potentially preventing costly mistakes and disputes as AI-powered shopping grows.

topIndia.title: High data centre, chip costs and cheaper AI models pose risks to capacity usage: Infosys CEO
topIndia.summary: High data centre and chip costs, coupled with emerging AI models offering cheaper inference, pose risks to AI infrastructure investments and future capacity utilisation, Infosys CEO Salil Parekh said.
